harness: Claude Code with kmaudit's APM package installed (the skills, the kmaudit-check-writer agent and the kmaudit MCP server) and mcp__kmaudit__* allowed; eval 4 runs where no agent exists

evals.name: code-backed-claims
evals.repo: tests/fixtures/audit_repo.py's repository with three stored claims (store_claims): two the code bears out, one it does not
evals.expected_output: The kmaudit-check-writer agent tests each check with the checks_try MCP tool, stores it with checks_submit, and marks the false claim as drift; the main session sees only the summary.
expectations: The main session calls checks_todo first and dispatches kmaudit-check-writer with the concept paths it lists
The agent calls mcp__kmaudit__checks_try before mcp__kmaudit__checks_submit and runs no shell command
The two true claims hold with code steps that are not weak
The SQLite claim is stored as drift with a one-sentence reason
The main session's transcript holds the summary but no step

evals.name: claims-the-repo-lacks
evals.prompt: write checks for the bundle's claims
evals.repo: the extract-claims eval repository after /extract-claims: 22 checkable claims, most about files the fixture does not have
evals.expected_output: Each claim gets a check or a reason; claims about missing files are drift or reasons, never bent until they hold.
expectations: Checks on files the repository lacks are marked drift rather than rewritten to hold

evals.name: no-claims-yet
evals.repo: a repository with an .okf/ bundle and no stored claims
evals.expected_output: checks_todo reports 0 checkable claims, so the skill points to /extract-claims and dispatches no agent.

evals.name: no-agent-harness
evals.repo: the repository of eval 1, in a harness with the kmaudit MCP server and no kmaudit-check-writer agent (Antigravity or OpenCode)
evals.expected_output: The main session works through the batch itself with checks_todo, checks_try and checks_submit, then reports the same summary.
expectations: Every claim gets a check or reason through the checks_submit MCP tool, each check tried first with checks_try
No kmaudit shell command is run
